replies.author: @DiscoverGlobePlacesTop10_NL158

replies.author: @Chris_at_Home
replies.text: I moved here in 1979. I had a job that paid  $18k a year in 1978 which was pretty good back then.  My 1st year here I made $26k. I changed jobs and in 1981 I was making over $65k a year. I had 9 jobs and everyone paid more. By 2005 I was making $117k.  I didn’t have college but just some electronics training from the military. Most of these jobs were in the oil field or along the pipeline working half a year on a two week at work and then two week off schedule. The income more than paid for my cost of living. First off we don’t have any state taxes, only borough property taxes. Most people I worked with had a home and a cabin somewhere. We also had our toys with things like boats, snowmachines and ATVs. Myself I had an airplane by the mid 1980s. I don’t fly anymore but have the other toys and an off-road cabin. Life has been great… so far.
